livemode.description: true when the request used a live key; false for test keys and sandbox. Stripe-style.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

origin.description: `api` — submitted via the public API; `console` — uploaded via the dashboard; `system` — generated internally (e.g. auto-probe, fixture seeding, run_prompt). System analyses are never billed. Agents should normally only process api/console-origin analyses. (Renamed 2026-07-27: former value `user` is now `api`.)

query.description: CompiledQuery (schema at /v1/schemas/compiled-query.json). Always populated in responses.

assessable.description: True when the query type can produce a yes/no/count answer.

discount_pct.description: 0 for the first (full-price) prompt; 50 for additional prompts.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD. Null when video has no known duration.

estimated_seconds.description: Estimated credit-seconds for this prompt. Null when video has no known duration.

estimated_total_cost_usd.description: Estimated total cost in USD. Null when duration unknown.

estimated_total_seconds.description: Estimated total credit-seconds for all prompts combined (full + discounted). Null when the video has no known duration.

assessable.description: False for open_ended queries — the model cannot score them, so detections will be empty.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost at current pricing. Null when duration is unknown.

estimated_seconds.description: Billable seconds this analysis would consume. Null when duration is unknown.

parse_mode.description: How the prompt was compiled. "client" means you supplied query directly.

query.description: The compiled query the analysis would run.

video_duration_s.description: Null when duration is not yet known (probe pending).

AnalysisStatus.description: Analysis lifecycle state (§14.2). Clients MUST tolerate unknown future non-terminal values.

AnalysisUsage.description: Terminal only. fps-independent clock seconds (pricing doc). credit_balance_after is the balance immediately after THIS analysis settled — an immutable point-in-time snapshot; it does not change as later analyses run. Null when the account row is unavailable (e.g. free-grant exhausted before settlement).

Artifacts.description: Signed URL TTL 1h; re-fetch GET analysis for a fresh URL.

token.description: 256-bit CSPRNG bearer, SHA-256 at rest — shown exactly once. Browser-safe: accepted on product-plane endpoints (CORS *).

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

prompts.description: 2–10 prompts to run against the video. First prompt is full price; each additional is 50%.

validate_only.description: Dry-run mode. When true, parses all prompts and returns an analysis_batch_preview (HTTP 200) with per-prompt cost estimates. No credits are reserved and no jobs are created.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

model.description: Defaults to latest; response always echoes the concrete version.

prompt.description: Free text — compiled server-side. Exactly one of prompt/query.

validate_only.description: Dry run (PRI-480). Compiles the prompt, reports whether the query is assessable, and estimates duration/cost — WITHOUT creating an analysis, touching the GPU, or burning credits. Returns an AnalysisPreview (object: "analysis_preview") with 200, not an Analysis. Use it to check a prompt before paying for it.

webhook.description: Per-request webhook override (delivery ships P7). Write-only — never echoed.

scopes.description: Non-empty subset of the §4.9 scope set. Must also be a subset of the minting key’s scopes.

stream_id.description: Optional resource binding to one stream (WS acceptance ships P6).

ttl_s.description: Token lifetime in seconds (60–900, default 900). Tokens are never refreshable — mint a new one.

video_id.description: Optional resource binding: narrows the token to this one video. Mutually exclusive with stream_id.

CreateStreamRequest.description: Requires positive credit balance. One queued|ready|live stream per account by default (409 stream_already_active otherwise).

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

prompt.description: Free text — compiled server-side. Exactly one of prompt/query.

webhook.description: Per-request webhook override (delivery ships P7). Write-only.

CreateVideoRequest.description: Exactly one mode: presigned ({filename?, content_type, size_bytes?}) or ingest ({url}). Unknown fields are rejected.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

url.description: URL-ingest mode: https-only, SSRF-guarded (§18.2). Mutually exclusive with filename/size_bytes.

events.description: Subscribed event types — a non-empty subset of the closed v1 vocabulary.

CreditPricing.description: Current pricing configuration. Data-driven — a price change is a config update, not a schema change.

auto_refill_threshold_seconds.description: Balance below which auto-refill (if enabled) triggers.

card_grant_seconds.description: Bonus credit-seconds granted when a card is added.

price_per_second_cents.description: Price per billed video-second, in cents. Cost of an analysis = usage.billed_seconds × this value.

signup_grant_seconds.description: Free credit-seconds granted on signup / free-grant upgrade.

balance_seconds.description: Seconds of analysis remaining. The authoritative balance.

grant_seconds.description: Original signup grant, when one exists.

used_seconds.description: Consumed against the signup grant (grant minus balance).

claim_url.description: Open in browser for the user to approve.

device_code.description: Opaque code; use as path param when polling.

Meter.description: One named usage meter (§4.6). The list is data-driven — pricing changes add/change rows, never the schema.

prompt.description: Free-text video question. Must be a non-empty string.
prompt.example: Is there a dog in this video?

compiled_query.description: CompiledQuery — canonical JSON Schema served at /v1/schemas/compiled-query.json. Same structure accepted by POST /v1/analyses `query`.

parse_mode.description: How the prompt was compiled: "haiku" = LLM parser; "heuristic" = deterministic fallback (used when the LLM is unavailable).

Progress.description: Non-terminal only. percent is monotonic non-decreasing per analysis.

Result.description: Analysis result — the product (§13.3). Reserved (always absent in v1): masks, bounding_boxes, events.

api_key.description: Shown exactly once — store it now. Fixture-only test mode: no GPU, no credits.

expected_answer.description: Deterministic canned answer for the fixture prompt — assert this in CI.

fixture_video_id.description: Pre-seeded ready video for immediate POST /v1/analyses.

failure_diagnostic.description: Present when end_reason is ice_failed (and some media_timeout cases): ICE candidate summary from the server side — {local_candidates: string[], hint}. Use it to distinguish "server advertised only private/host candidates" from "client could not reach relay".

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

results_summary.description: Terminal summary: {result_frames, frames (deprecated alias of result_frames — removed ~2026-08-28), last_detections}. result_frames counts result EVENTS emitted (results are sampled, not per-source-frame). Detection rows use the same enums/casing as the file-API result contract (answer: yes|no|indeterminate, lowercase; prompt echoed exactly as submitted).

StreamEndReason.description: Why the stream ended. completed — normal end after live. canceled — ended before going live (client action). insufficient_credits — balance exhausted. error — server-side failure. timeout — max_session_s cutoff. ice_failed — WebRTC ICE never connected (see failure_diagnostic). media_timeout — connected but no media/results within the first-frame window. A stream that never went live is never `completed`.

StreamSignaling.description: Present while the stream is joinable; null once ended.

url.description: Versioned signaling WS. Auth: ?token= accepts a client token (pvct_) or first-party Clerk JWT — NEVER a secret key.

StreamStatus.description: Stream lifecycle state (§4.8): queued → ready → live → ended. Terminal immutable.

StreamUsage.description: Terminal only. Same ledger as uploads — one balance.

billed_seconds.description: LIVE-clock seconds (join/negotiation free). fps-independent by construction.

api_key.description: The raw `pv_live_` key — store securely, shown only once.

UsageResponse.description: Usage meters + legacy dashboard fields (the flat fields are deprecated in favor of meters[]; they remain during the web-client migration).

meters.description: Data-driven meter list (§4.6 invariant #1). At launch: credit_seconds (balance) + seconds_processed.period (used/resets_at). Pricing changes add/change rows — never the schema. quota_exceeded errors carry details.meter naming which meter tripped.

livemode.description: true when the request used a live key; false for test keys and sandbox. Stripe-style.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata. ≤16 keys, key ≤40 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], value ≤500 chars.

VideoUpload.description: Presigned upload instructions. Present only while awaiting_upload. URL TTL 1h.

WebhookDelivery.description: One event→endpoint delivery record (§16.3). Dead-lettered rows visible 30 days.

event_id.description: Stable across retries — consumers dedupe on this.

WebhookEndpoint.description: A customer webhook endpoint (§4.5). Standard Webhooks signing.

disabled_reason.description: auto_failure = 72h of 100% delivery failure (§16.3). Re-enable via POST …/enable.

secret.description: Signing secret — returned EXACTLY ONCE (create / rotate_secret), never readable again.

WebhookEventType.description: Closed v1 event vocabulary (§4.5). Payload = the full resource DTO.

bearerAuth.description: API key (pv_live_… / pv_test_…). Clerk session JWTs are accepted on the same endpoints for first-party clients.

info.description: Public API v1 for Primate Vision — video understanding for the agentic web. P1 (PRI-430) publishes resource schemas; endpoints ship from P3 onward.
info.title: Primate Vision API

parameters.description: Filter by public analysis status (§13.2 vocabulary): queued | preparing | analyzing | rendering | completed | failed | canceled. E.g. status=analyzing returns currently-running analyses. Unknown values → 400 validation_failed.
parameters.name: status

200.description: List envelope (§13.4).

get.summary: List analyses (filters: status, video_id, model, created_*)

post.description: Async by default: 202 + poll. `Prefer: wait=<s>` (≤120) blocks and returns the terminal resource when it finishes in time. Test-mode keys (pv_test_) return deterministic canned results with no GPU time and no credit burn. Set `validate_only: true` to dry-run a prompt — returns an AnalysisPreview with cost/assessability and creates nothing.

parameters.description: §16.1: first request wins; 24h replay window; same key + different body → 409 idempotency_key_reused.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Terminal resource (Prefer: wait satisfied, or test mode) — OR an AnalysisPreview when validate_only:true was sent. Discriminate on the `object` field.

202.description: Queued. Response echoes the compiled query and honest queue_position.

post.description: Pricing: first prompt billed at full price; each additional prompt billed at 50%. Credits are reserved per-prompt at the discounted rate so the ledger shows the discount directly. Returns an `analysis_batch` containing all analysis DTOs plus a `pricing` summary. Each analysis can be polled individually via `GET /v1/analyses/{id}`. Pass `validate_only: true` for a cost-estimate dry-run (HTTP 200, no credits reserved).

200.description: Dry-run preview (validate_only: true). Prompts parsed; cost estimated; no credits reserved, no jobs created.

202.description: Batch queued. All analyses dispatched; poll each `id` individually.

post.summary: Submit 2–10 prompts against the same video (batch discount)

200.description: The analysis. progress uses the canonical stage set queued→preparing→analyzing→rendering.

get.summary: Fetch an analysis (live progress while running)

200.description: Canceled (or best-effort race documented in §14.2).

post.description: Server-side token exchange (§4.9): authenticate with a secret key (or first-party session), receive a short-lived scoped pvct_ bearer for the browser. The browser then calls Primate directly — your secret key never leaves your server. Tokens are revoked implicitly when the minting key is revoked (≤5s). Rate class: 120/min per key. Client tokens can never mint tokens.

201.description: Token minted. The raw token appears only in this response.

400.description: validation_failed — scopes/ttl_s/binding violations, all listed at once.

403.description: insufficient_scope — requested scopes exceed the minting key’s, or the caller is itself a client token.

404.description: resource_not_found — video_id binding does not resolve to an owned video.

post.summary: Mint an ephemeral browser-safe client token (pvct_)

200.description: Pricing config. Billing unit is source-clock video-seconds; analysis cost = usage.billed_seconds × price_per_second_cents.

get.description: Agent-facing billing truth (PRI-480 A-5): remaining balance in billable seconds plus a paginated ledger. Check this before submitting work to avoid a 402. Requires the billing:read scope.

schema.description: Cursor — return transactions older than this id.

200.description: Balance plus one page of ledger entries.
Closed registry — codes are append-only; SDK retry policy generates from retryable/idem flags.

post.description: Stage 2 of the key lifecycle. Optional auth (test or live key accepted, or none). Returns a `device_code` and `claim_url`. Direct the user to `claim_url` to sign in; poll `GET /v1/keys/request/{code}` until status changes from `pending`. Key is delivered once in the claim response; subsequent polls return 410.
post.summary: Start a device-code claim flow for a full billed key

get.description: Returns `{status: "pending"}` until the user approves in the browser. After approval, returns `status: "consumed"` (key was delivered in the claim response). Expired or already-consumed codes return 410.

200.description: Current status of the device code.

410.description: device_code_expired — code consumed or expired. Start a new request.

post.description: Stage 1 of the key lifecycle. Call with a `pv_test_` key in Authorization; receive a `pv_live_` key with `tier: free_grant` and a 6,000-second credit grant. No email, card, or human-in-the-loop required. IP-limited (3 upgrades / IP / 24h).

201.description: Live key issued. The raw `api_key` appears only in this response.

403.description: test_mode_only — must call with a pv_test_ key.

429.description: upgrade_limit_exceeded — per-IP or global daily cap reached.

post.summary: Upgrade a test key to a live free-grant key (6,000s credit)

200.description: Model catalog. Requests may say model:"latest"; responses always name the concrete version.

post.description: Stateless prompt compiler. Auth optional (anonymous allowed); rate-limited to 30 req/min per IP. Never touches the GPU and never burns credits — use POST /v1/analyses with validate_only:true when you also want cost/assessability estimates.

200.description: The compiled query and which parser produced it.

400.description: empty_prompt — prompt missing, not a string, or blank.

422.description: parse_failed — prompt could not be compiled into a query.

post.summary: Compile a free-text prompt into a CompiledQuery (no analysis created)

post.description: Anonymous zero-touch provisioning (A1). Issues a fixture-only test-mode key: analyses return deterministic canned results, never touch the GPU, and burn no credits. IP-limited; 7-day expiry. Live keys require signup (billing gate, not an integration gate).

201.description: Sandbox key issued. The raw key appears only in this response.

429.description: sandbox_limit_exceeded — IP daily cap reached. Retry-After set.

post.summary: Provision an instant sandbox (pv_test_) key — no auth, no card

200.description: List envelope (§13.4).

post.description: Returns the signaling WS URL, ephemeral ICE servers, and session limits. Signaling protocol v1: join → ready|queued(position) → offer/answer/ice → live; mid-stream update_prompt, metering (5s ticks), warning, end {reason}. WS auth: ?token= accepts a client token (pvct_) or first-party session JWT — never a secret key. Billed per second of live clock time (join/negotiation free) from the same credit ledger as uploads.

parameters.description: §16.1: first request wins; 24h replay window; same key + different body → 409 idempotency_key_reused.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: Stream created (queued or ready). Response carries signaling.url + ice_servers + limits.

409.description: stream_already_active — one queued|ready|live stream per account (also the un-keyed-retry guard, §31-F2) / idempotency_key_reused.

503.description: capacity_exhausted (with Retry-After) — slot queue beyond the hard cap.

200.description: The stream. Terminal streams carry usage {billed_seconds, credit_balance_after} + duration_s + results_summary.

get.summary: Fetch a stream (usage + results summary once ended)

post.description: Graceful end: settles the credit reservation for the billed live-clock seconds (releases it entirely when the stream never went live). Ending an already-ended stream returns the terminal resource unchanged.

200.description: The ended stream with final usage.
Meters + legacy fields. Same numbers as the dashboard (shared service, reconciles with the credit ledger to the second).
List envelope (§13.4).

parameters.description: §16.1: first request wins; 24h replay window; same key + different body → 409 idempotency_key_reused.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: Video created. Presigned mode → status awaiting_upload with upload instructions; URL mode → status processing (async fetch).

post.summary: Create a video (presigned upload or URL ingest)

200.description: Deleted.

delete.summary: Delete a video (409 while analyses are non-terminal on it)

200.description: The video.
Size verified (±5% of declaration); video is ready.

post.summary: Signal that the presigned S3 PUT finished

200.description: List envelope.

post.description: Standard Webhooks signing (webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature). The secret appears ONLY in this response. Delivery contract: 10s timeout, retries 1m/5m/30m/2h/8h/24h with jitter, at-least-once, no ordering — dedupe on the evt_ id. Endpoints failing 100% for 72h are auto-disabled with an email notice. At most 10 endpoints per account.

parameters.description: §16.1: first request wins; 24h replay window; same key + different body → 409 idempotency_key_reused.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: Endpoint created. `secret` is returned exactly once.

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint (returns the one-time whsec_ secret)

200.description: {id, object, deleted: true}.
The endpoint.

get.summary: Fetch a webhook endpoint (secret never included)

get.description: Dead-lettered deliveries stay visible for 30 days. Deliveries carry the evt_ id (stable across retries), attempt count, last response status/error, and next retry time.

200.description: List envelope (newest first).

get.summary: List recent deliveries (last 100, with response codes)

post.summary: Redeliver a delivery now (works on failed/dead rows)

200.description: The re-enabled endpoint.

post.summary: Re-enable a disabled endpoint (clears auto-disable state)

post.description: Returns the NEW secret exactly once. The previous secret keeps signing deliveries for 24h so receivers can migrate without dropped verifications — the signature header carries one signature per active secret.

200.description: Endpoint with the new one-time `secret`.

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret (24h dual-secret overlap)
